name: TalentDealMemoManager
tagline: From offer to fully executed deal memo – with approvals, signatures, options and start dates under control.
description: A complete business affairs app for film, TV and live entertainment talent deals: dashboard with talent budget per project, deal pipeline, deals grid, key dates, deal detail with generated memo text, approval limit, signature chain and option tracking. Drop it into a canvas or model-driven app and connect your data in a few clicks.
features: Approval limit on deal value and backend %
Signature chain: sent → talent signed → fully executed
Talent budget vs committed per project
Bulk owner / status with undo, CSV export
Demo mode with fictional sample deals
